name: LienDeadline
tagline: Mechanics lien and preliminary notice deadlines for construction suppliers.
description: US mechanics lien and preliminary notice deadlines for construction material suppliers, with statute-cited lien guides for all 50 states and DC.

env.name: LIENDEADLINE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional dedicated customer key for the customer invoice tools; the supplier calculation and state guides need no key.

install.notes: Runs locally over stdio and needs Node.js 22 or newer. Only calculate_lien_deadline and list_supported_states need LIENDEADLINE_API_KEY; the other three tools work without it.
